scope: Actual final/body AAC, selected-source voice WAV, premix and known constant BGM; numerical provenance/signal checks only.
limitations: AAC is lossy; measured offsets, coverage, padding and correlations are reported.
Source/waveform consistency cannot determine spoken words or pronunciation.
Known-BGM regression is not blind voice isolation or whole-film listening.
Actual visual review and browser/native VTT behavior are separate checks.

mixedSourceIdentity.scope: 17 source raw/48k/request identities verified exactly. Fresh global normalization/assembly may change normalized PCM; current whole-track/source audits and encoded numerics are separately mandatory.

scriptBinding.scope: Exact text equality, not ASR or spoken-word listening.

review.scope: Source-level low-energy flags retained as pacing, not gaps introduced by cutting or assembly. No claim that words or naturalness were listened to.

retainedSourceSignalFlags.note: Source pause screening flags remain recorded; no spoken-word or naturalness judgment is claimed.

bodyGate.checks: Source hashes, format, frames, audio, loudness and full decode passed.
bodyGate.scope: Actual body only; unchanged canonical checker in a disposable repository-shaped symlink view.
bodyGate.stageInputs: Same frozen files; body mapped to temporary video.mp4. No source/media generated.

result.scope: Numerical waveform and source-content consistency only. No ASR, pronunciation, voice-isolation or listening claim.
result.offsetConvention: decoded[t + sampleOffset] corresponds to reference[t]; positive means decoded is delayed.

intentionalMixModel.note: Known BGM is longer than this episode. Regression estimates gains; it does not rerun production normalization or limiting.

limitations: AAC is lossy and may include codec tail padding.
Final loudnorm/alimiter may cause a fixed small delay; the actual delay is reported separately.
Waveform/source matching cannot determine spoken words, numerical pronunciation or human understanding.
The two-source regression checks this constant-mode known-music mix; it is not blind source separation.

sourceMeasurements.innerDropoutsFieldMeaning: Shared legacy field for >=.50s low-level intervals, not speech-recognition evidence of missing words. These flagged source intervals were preserved and reviewed numerically.
